data.description:
Placeholder epic for pre-surfacing verifier per code-review calibration analysis (see bug d42d-8126-492c-44c4 and conversation thread).

## Goal

Build a new `code-reviewer-verifier` sub-agent that runs unconditionally between every reviewer and `record-review.sh`, independently re-reading each cited file/excerpt to confirm the asserted defect is real, and emitting one of `confirm | downgrade-to-minor | drop` per finding before findings reach the PR or autonomous-resolution loop.

## Why this is needed

The existing `code-reviewer-arbiter` is a *post-defense* dispute adjudicator (trinary SUSTAIN / ACCEPT_DEFENSE / DOWNGRADE), invoked only on `ESCALATE_REVIEW` or `oscillation_no_arbiter_engagement` signals. It cannot catch the d42d failure modes (misread, hallucinated off-by-one, stale line ref) because invalid findings reach the PR untouched and consume autonomous-resolution attempts before any defense escalates them. A separate pre-surfacing verifier is needed.

PR-80 evidence: 8 of 11 round-2 findings invalid or overstated; an autonomous-resolution agent acting on them would have introduced complexity for non-bugs (flock wrapper for non-existent race in N3, refactored loops to fix non-existent off-by-one in N1).

## Scope (high-level — to be decomposed)

1. New agent file `plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-verifier.md` with input/output contract.
2. Dispatch step in `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py` between reviewer dispatch and `record-review.sh`.
3. Schema for verifier ruling per finding; integration with the new `cited_excerpt` field (Approach 1) so verification is anchored.
4. Behavioral test fixtures: known-misread diff, known-hallucinated diff, known-valid diff.
5. Telemetry: drop/downgrade/confirm counts per cycle so we can measure the calibration delta.

## Dependencies

- Approach 1 (`cited_excerpt` required field) lands first — verifier uses excerpts as the anchor for its file reads.
- Approach 2 (reachability sentence on `critical`/`important`) lands first — verifier checks reachability claim.
- Approach 4 (minor-finding ticket gate) lands first — verifier downgrades flow into the gated-comment path.

## Out of scope for this epic placeholder

This ticket is a placeholder for /dso:preplanning to decompose into stories. Do not implement directly.
data.title: Pre-surfacing reviewer-findings verifier agent (Approach 3)
